The revocation was performed by the order itself when the President signed it on September 17, 1981, so the clause is spent from that date; the order sets no other effective date. research_rationale:
basis_pattern: original_plus_bounded_search. EO 12322 (signed 1981-09-17; 46 FR 46561; official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12322.txt, read in full) requires water resources reports, proposals and plans to be submitted to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget before they go to the Congress, directs the Director to examine and advise on them, requires the advice to accompany later submissions, and revokes Executive Order No. 12113. Identity: the Title 3 heading of Executive Order 12322 of September 17, 1981, on water resources projects at 46 FR 46561, the title and the date agree with the register row. The dossier inventory has eight clauses (the authority lead-in, sections 1 to 4 and paragraphs (a) to (c) of section 2); I confirmed it without correction. Own terms: sections 1 to 3 have no end date or ending condition; section 4 is a self-executing revocation of EO 12113 performed on issuance and recorded as terminated on 1981-09-17; section 2(b) was amended by EO 12608. Later instruments: a search of every held order text for the number 12322 finds EO 12608 section 31 (the only amendment, attached as a later event to section 2(b)), the order's own Federal Register copy, the 1989 codification snapshot, a 2008 Federal Register notice and 43 CFR 404.51, which rely on the order as current; no held text revokes or supersedes it. The three selected machine searches (current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog) were read with their coverage notes, carry no coverage warning, and record 3, 3 and 1 hits for the order number respectively. Limit stated plainly: the continuing predicate rests on the held original text, the held amendment and the bounded searches (U.S. Code through 2026-10-09); the guidelines that section 2(b) now names are not held, and 43 CFR 404.51 is a lead, not a packet source.
